Self.Wiki: This map object represents a part within the map.

InstanceID.Wiki: Determines the instance of this map object. Should be unique between map objects of the same model name.

ModelName.Wiki: The model of the map object, corresponding to an entry in the ModelParam.

Rotation.Wiki: Rotation of the map object, in degrees.

Scale.Wiki: Scale of the map object, only meaningful for map pieces and objects.

MapStudioLayer.Wiki: The map layer this map object is placed on.

SibPath.Wiki: A path to a .sib file, presumed to be some kind of editor placeholder.

DisplayData.Wiki: Display and draw groups, with an alternate set of each that the game can swap or merge in on load. Same layout as Elden Ring.

DisplayGroups.Wiki: The groups this map object shows; for a collision, the groups shown while the player stands on it.

AltDisplayGroups.Wiki: Display groups that replace, or are merged into, the display groups when Use Alternate Groups is ON.

AltDisplayGroupsMask.Wiki: When merging, the display group bits set here are kept; the rest come from the alternate display groups.

DrawGroups.Wiki: Controls when the map object is visible: it is drawn while any of these groups is shown.

AltDrawGroups.Wiki: Draw groups merged into the draw groups when Use Alternate Groups is ON.

AltDrawGroupsMask.Wiki: When merging, the draw group bits set here are kept; the rest come from the alternate draw groups.

NoAltGroupMerge.Wiki: If ON, the alternate groups are never merged in, only swapped in whole.

UseAltGroups.Wiki: Enables the alternate groups. Depending on a game state, the display groups are replaced by the alternate display groups, or both sets are merged in through their masks.

DispGroups.Wiki: Controls when the map object is visible.

EntityID.Wiki: Identifies the map object in event scripts.

EntityGroupIDs.Wiki: A entity group ID this map object belongs to

LightID.Wiki: The ID of the value set from LightSet ParamEditor to use.

FogID.Wiki: The ID of the value set from FogParamEditor to use.

TransitionTime.Wiki: Amount of time it takes for GParam to transition (in seconds). -1 = Some default time.

GrassParamIds.Wiki: The ID in GrassTypeParam determining properties of dynamic grass on a map piece.
